query:
SELECT c.body_markdown, c.created_at AS "created_at: cannery_core::timestamps::Timestamp", a.sequence AS "sequence?", coalesce(u.display_name, u.email, 'a researcher') AS "author!"
           FROM comments c JOIN users u ON u.id=c.author_user LEFT JOIN attempts a ON a.id=c.attempt_id
           WHERE c.hypothesis_id=$1 ORDER BY c.created_at, c.id
